title: Smith's Dream
description: A mod that upgrades the current arsenal of weapons and also adds a new arsenal of armor and weapons
body:
# **A Smith’s Dream**
A mod in which gives the player new upgraded tools of the current minecraft, a stronger version of the tools:
- Stone
- Gold
- Iron
- Diamond
- Netherite

**With said upgraded tools comes with more durability, speed, and strength to the upgraded tools, however at the cost of upgraded blocks**

## New Tools
Along with this comes the new netherite also known as Zirconium, which adds a new block, ingots, set of tools and armor.
	An extra note, a new ingot and set of tools called SteamSmith are the best tools that this mod has to offer.

# Note
This mod was made just to add new tools to the game, and updates do come randomly. The names for everything new is broken, but shouldn't change the gameplay for the mod. This mod is **Highly recommend playing with Just Enough Items(JEI) or Roughly Enough Items(REI) because of the recipes being difficult to figure out without these mods.** Hope anyone that downloads this mod enjoys the mod. Alr bye.
